study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective, hospital-based, cohort study
cohort: Pregnant women recruited from antenatal clinics in Ho Chi Minh City between 19(+ 0)-22(+ 6) weeks gestation
finding: GDM and obesity, particularly in combination, were associated with increased risks of adverse perinatal outcomes, including preterm birth, LGA, and caesarean section, in a Vietnamese cohort.
mod_finding: Obese women with GDM had the highest risk of caesarean section.
